description.zh: Three.js 霓虹跑酷：变道、跳跃、收集小黄鸭，躲开追击的狐狸。
description.en: A Three.js neon runner — switch lanes, jump, collect ducks, and outrun the fox.

description.zh: Three.js 3D 空战：锁定导弹、波次敌机与 StepFun TTS 中文语音，零构建静态站点。
description.en: Three.js 3D air combat — lock-on missiles, waves of enemies, and StepFun TTS voice lines; zero-build static site.

description.zh: Apple 风格的深色产品发布页：大标题、设备展示与预约表单。
description.en: An Apple-style dark launch page with hero type, device frame, and signup form.

description.zh: Google Material 风格的静态数据看板：指标卡、图表与项目列表。
description.en: A Material-inspired static dashboard with metrics, charts, and project rows.

description.zh: 编辑式作品集站点：大字号排版、案例网格与引言区块。
description.en: An editorial portfolio with display type, case grid, and quote section.

description.zh: 阶跃星辰 3D 数字藏馆：三件 glTF 藏品悬浮于星海中，可拖动旋转凝视。
description.en: StepFun 3D pavilion — three glTF artifacts in a starfield you can orbit and inspect.

description.zh: 品牌与数字体验设计工作室的静态主站：成果展示、深浅主题、点阵字标与 SVG 交互动效。
description.en: A static brand and digital design studio website with a project showcase, light/dark themes, a dot-matrix wordmark, and interactive SVG animations.

title.zh: Meridian · 全球运营指挥中心

description.zh: 全球运营数据看板：KPI、大区达成、营收趋势、贸易网络、告警与订单明细，支持深浅主题、区域下钻和搜索排序。
description.en: A global operations dashboard with KPIs, regional performance, revenue trends, trade networks, alerts, and searchable orders, plus light/dark themes and regional drill-down.

title.zh: AURELLE · 静奢护肤与高定美妆

description.zh: 静奢美妆品牌电商演示：品牌与产品展示、实时搜索、快速查看和本地购物袋，支持响应式布局；不包含真实订单或支付服务。
description.en: A luxury beauty storefront demo with brand storytelling, product search, quick view, and a local shopping bag in a responsive layout; no real ordering or payment services.

description.zh: 把手机变成星球探测器：相机取景、倾斜操控、定位探索与震动反馈。H5 + 原生桥接，产出 Android APK，扫码下载；iPhone 安装需另行签名或 TestFlight。
description.en: Turn your phone into a planet scanner with camera, tilt controls, location exploration, and haptics. H5 + native bridges produce an Android APK for QR download; iPhone installation requires signing or TestFlight.

title.zh: StepCode iPhone Duo 发布短片

description.zh: 用 LaunchMotion skill 复刻的 6.8 秒发布短片：StepCode 移动版跑在真机比例的 Apple iPhone Duo 上——铰链处微拍拉远露出整机、标志性折叠时封面屏接力对话、展开后双屏分屏（左屏会话列表、右屏当前任务）。StepFun 品牌风格：Signal Blue 单一强调色、Ink Black 深色画布、PT Mono 结构化数据。
description.en: A 6.8-second launch film built with the LaunchMotion skill: the StepCode mobile app on a true-to-scale Apple iPhone Duo — a macro pull-back at the hinge, the cover screen picking up the chat through the signature fold, then a split view (sessions left, current task right). StepFun brand language: one Signal Blue accent, ink-black canvas, PT Mono for structured data.
